profile.headline: Senior Software Architect and Product Development Manager.
profile.summary:
Extensive software design & development experience with a variety of Java technologies including both web and desktop application development.  Have worked with both large and small teams on both large, enterprise class and single-user products.  Experienced playing different roles from technical lead to product architect to direct manager.

Particularly adept at developing architectural solutions to complex problems and communicating the 'vision' of that solution to create buy-in among vested parties.  And I also love working directly with the code!

Specialties: I have spent much of the last couple of years working with Hadoop and Accumulo on big data analytics.  Other advanced technologies I have worked with extensively include most J2EE technologies (Servlets, Portlets, EJBs, JMS, JNDI, etc.), OSGI/Eclipse, Swing, XML, XPath, CORBA, etc. I have worked with multiple dbms types including Oracle, MS SQL Server, DB2, mySQL and Derby.

positions.title: Principle Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Design & Implementation specializing in Java web and desktop technologies but with a strength in integration with other technologies.  Experienced in both individual and team projects of all sizes including direct management.  Major emphasis on 'big data' processing and analytics.

positions.title: Principal Engineer / Development Manager
positions.description:
° Led development team responsible for MICROS' two analytical products, XBR Loss Prevention and Balance Sales Audit.  Successful development and release of versions 6.5 and 6.7 of both products,  including multiple maintenance releases of older releases.  Introduced extensive improvements to development and quality control processes including formalizing change management through integrated use of issue tracking and version control tooling.  Worked closely with operational teams to support deployment of products to customers, including customized change implementation and issue resolution.
° Responsible for technical roadmap, high-level architectural design & detailed technical designs for both the web-based (Java) and desktop (Powerbuilder) analysis tools.  Emphasis on gradual migration of technology from legacy single-user desktop application to large-scale, multi-user and multi-organization hosted, “Software as Service” web architecture, re-implementing components from PowerBuilder to Java and J2EE-based technologies.
° Led design and development of significant refactoring of XBR's web-based product to rearchitect it for larger-scale and international deployments.  Technologies used include Servlets, XML, Portlets, JSPs, Applets, Swing, JDBC, Spring, JasperReport, etc..  Database types used included Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, DB2 and others.  Most recent tasks included a near complete reorganization of the code to modularize the development process and to support mult-customer hosting.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
° Led design and development of code governing all lifecycle aspects of the Eclipse/OSGi-based IBM Lotus Expediter™ (formerly Workplace Managed Client™) Technologies including install, configuration and launch of the runtime platform and provisioning, configuration and update of features and plugins (bundles).   Advanced capabilities include centrally managed (web-deployed) installation and configuration of client features and ability to host multiple composite applications per runtime instance.  This platform forms the core foundation for multiple rich client applications from IBM including the Lotus Notes™ client as of version 8.0 and Sametime™ version 7.5.
° Led proof-of-concept project demonstrating integration of Activity-Centric-Collaboration (a social-computing) technology of the IBM Workplace Managed Client™ with other IBM WebSphere™ -based systems, including both user-driven and autonomous integration.  
° Built SDK for ISV development of Activities-related applications and extensions and integration of Activity-Centric-Collaboration technologies shipped with the Lotus Notes™ Client v8.0.  Provided extensible means of integrating use of arbitrary data types (and associated operations) into any application.
° Performed multiple duties for IBM's Extreme Blue internship program which is both a recruiting vehicle, drawing in the most talented students from across the globe and a leading technology incubator, responsible for the birth of many leading edge technologies. Duties included soliciting for and assessing project proposals, recruiting, interviewing and selection of students, mentoring and providing technical, logistical and coordination support for projects.

positions.title: Senior Software Architect
positions.description:
° Designed and Led team development of a comprehensive Java-based framework (Framework1440™) for rapidly building secure, scalable multi-user n-tier network applications.  Framework1440™ provides a pre-built set of commonly-used services such as authentication, access control, session management, logging, document management, deployment configuration management and others.  By utilizing several powerful design patterns, including MVC, Abstract Factory, Proxy and Decorator, the framework services are completely pluggable and customizable to fit application needs.  For example, while the baseline implementation of the Component Management services utilizes Enterprise Java Beans, they could also be re-implemented using COM, CORBA or JINI, depending on the needs of the customer, without changing a line of client application code. 
° Developed and implemented corporate standards for development and deployment of Java applications including coding standards, architecture strategies and overall development methodology.
° Provided architectural, design and deployment consultation for development of Builder1440, an Application Service Provider application that provides sales and project management services for the home building industry.  Builder1440 was built using the Framework1440 API on top of J2EE technologies, using Oracle and deployed on Windows and Solaris platforms. 
° Lead architect role in development of custom order-automation/procurement tracking web application for client in the printing industry.  This application was built using Framework1440 on top of J2EE technologies, uses Oracle  and was deployed on Linux.  This application also integrated with several legacy systems from third-party vendor.
